description: GIRL HERO concept photo day 1: Liz, Leeseo and Jang Wonyoung, 4 photos each, 12 total. Pop-art superhero portraits on bold solid backdrops, each member wears a metallic hero mask (Liz purple with heart emblem on blue backdrop, Wonyoung pink masquerade style on hot pink backdrop) with long satin gloves and spiked collar details, comic-book color blocking.
